audit.whatIsWrong: The first four rows gave Levels 1 through 5 to Jax while whys[0] through whys[3] all say the opposite — his bonesaw is percent-HP poke Counter Strike cannot dodge, his regen heals every scratch, and 'without Grievous Wounds you simply cannot kill through his sustain'. The entry is also tagged HARD but painted with the even/yellow tone, rated 6/10, and signed off as 'Even matchup' at 45.02% win rate.
audit.why: The mirror audit set both layers to Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo / Dr. Mundo / Jax / Jax / Jax, and this side's own reasons agree that the early lane is entirely his and Jax's window opens at 6.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 5 Dr. Mundo, Level 6 through two items Jax. Difficulty 7.5/10 with the hard tone.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and breakdown.late name Jax's ult 'Grandmaster’s Might'.
audit.why: The mirror audit found the same stale pre-rework name in four fields and flagged that the packet's near-miss detector never catches it because the name is correctly spelled, just obsolete.
audit.corrected: Grandmaster at Arms (110s at rank 1). Mundo's defining cooldown is Maximum Dosage — a flat 120s at every rank that instantly heals a percent of missing Health; that, not Heart Zapper, is what a Jax must wait out.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer tracks Heart Zapper as 'matchup-defining' and repeats 'Counter Strike flips every AA exchange'. Separately, the content layer calls his Q 'Infected Cleaver' in six places.
audit.why: The real name is Infected Bonesaw — a 4s, 975-range thrown skillshot dealing current-health damage. Counter Strike dodges attacks, so the bonesaw passes straight through it; E has value here only against his walk-up E-smash. Heart Zapper (17s) is a damage-store heal, not the thing that beats you. Also unmentioned anywhere: Goes Where He Pleases resists the first immobilising effect, so his passive can eat the Counter Strike stun outright.
audit.corrected: Infected Bonesaw (4s) is percent-HP poke your E cannot touch — sidestep it. Hold Counter Strike for his E-smash walk-up. Track Maximum Dosage (120s) and commit only once it is spent, with Grievous Wounds applied.
sources: enemyKit Q cd 4/range 975, P text, W cd 17, R cd 120

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Infected Cleaver' is a fabricated/obsolete ability name used across whys[0], spikes[0].text, content.early, content.mid, wants.you[0] and wants.foe[0]. The two names the packet flagged are false positives.
audit.why: Data Dragon gives Infected Bonesaw for the Q slot. "Counter Strike's" and "Maximum Dosage's" are real names with possessives.
